traditions.VUL: Vulgo dícitur :
traditions.KJV: They say ,

1.english_reference: If a man put away his wife , and she go from him , and become another man ’s

traditions.WLC: לֵ אמֹ֡ר הֵ֣ן יְשַׁלַּ֣ח אִ֣ישׁ אֶת אִשְׁתּ וֹ֩ וְ הָלְכָ֨ה מֵ אִתּ֜ וֹ וְ הָיְתָ֣ה לְ אִישׁ אַחֵ֗ר
traditions.LXX: Ἐὰν ἐξαποστείλῃ ἀνὴρ τὴν γυναῖκα αὐτοῦ , καὶ ἀπέλθῃ ἀπ᾽ αὐτοῦ καὶ γένηται ἀνδρὶ ἑτέρῳ ,
traditions.VUL: Si dimíserit vir uxórem suam , et recédens ab eo , dúxerit virum álterum :
traditions.KJV: If a man put away his wife , and she go from him , and become another man ’s ,

1.english_reference: shall he return unto her again ?

traditions.WLC: הֲ יָשׁ֤וּב אֵלֶ֨י הָ֙ ע֔וֹד
traditions.LXX: μὴ ἀνακάμπτουσα ἀνακάμψει πρὸς αὐτὸν ἔτι ;
traditions.VUL: numquid revertétur ad eam ultra ?
traditions.KJV: shall he return unto her again ?

1.english_reference: shall not that land be greatly polluted ?

traditions.WLC: הֲ ל֛וֹא חָנ֥וֹף תֶּחֱנַ֖ף הָ אָ֣רֶץ הַ הִ֑יא
traditions.LXX: οὐ μιαινομένη μιανθήσεται ἡ γυνὴ ἐκείνη ;
traditions.VUL: numquid non pollúta , et contamináta erit múlier illa ?
traditions.KJV: shall not that land be greatly polluted ?

1.english_reference: but thou hast played the harlot with many lovers

traditions.WLC: וְ אַ֗תְּ זָנִית֙ רֵעִ֣ים רַבִּ֔ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ σὺ ἐξεπόρνευσας ἐν ποιμέσιν πολλοῖς ,
traditions.VUL: tu autem fornicáta es cum amatóribus multis :
traditions.KJV: but thou hast played the harlot with many lovers ;

1.english_reference: yet return again to me , saith the LORD .

traditions.WLC: וְ שׁ֥וֹב אֵלַ֖ י נְאֻם יְהֹוָֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀνέκαμπτες πρὸς μέ ; λέγει Κύριος .
traditions.VUL: tamen revértere ad me , dicit Dóminus , et ego suscípiam te .
traditions.KJV: yet return again to me , saith the LORD .

2.english_reference: Lift up thine eyes unto the high places , and see where thou hast not been lien with .

traditions.WLC: שְׂאִֽי עֵינַ֨יִ ךְ עַל שְׁפָיִ֜ם וּ רְאִ֗י אֵיפֹה֙ לֹ֣א שגלת
traditions.LXX: ἆρον εἰς εὐθεῖαν τοὺς ὀφθαλμούς σου καὶ ἴδε · ποῦ οὐχὶ ἐξεφύρθης ;
traditions.VUL: Leva óculos tuos in diréctum , et vide ubi non prostráta sis :
traditions.KJV: Lift up thine eyes unto the high places , and see where thou hast not been lien with .

2.english_reference: In the ways hast thou sat for them , as the Arabian in the wilderness

traditions.WLC: עַל דְּרָכִים֙ יָשַׁ֣בְתְּ לָ הֶ֔ם כַּ עֲרָבִ֖י בַּ מִּדְבָּ֑ר
traditions.LXX: ἐπὶ ταῖς ὁδοῖς ἐκάθισας αὐτοῖς ὡσεὶ κορώνη ἐρημουμένη ,
traditions.VUL: in viis sedébas , exspéctans eos quasi latro in solitúdine :
traditions.KJV: In the ways hast thou sat for them , as the Arabian in the wilderness ;

2.english_reference: and thou hast polluted the land with thy whoredoms and with thy wickedness .

traditions.WLC: וַ תַּחֲנִ֣יפִי אֶ֔רֶץ בִּ זְנוּתַ֖יִ ךְ וּ בְ רָעָתֵֽ ךְ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐμίανας τὴν γῆν ἐν ταῖς πορνίαις σου καὶ ἐν ταῖς κακίαις σου ,
traditions.VUL: et polluísti terram in fornicatiónibus tuis , et in malítiis tuis .
traditions.KJV: and thou hast polluted the land with thy whoredoms and with thy wickedness .

3.english_reference: Therefore the showers have been withholden , and there hath been no latter rain

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּמָּנְע֣וּ רְבִבִ֔ים וּ מַלְק֖וֹשׁ ל֣וֹא הָיָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔσχες ποιμένας πολλοὺς εἰς πρόσκομμα σεαυτῇ ·
traditions.VUL: Quam ob rem prohíbitæ sunt stillæ pluviárum , et serótinus imber non fuit :
traditions.KJV: Therefore the showers have been withholden , and there hath been no latter rain ;

3.english_reference: and thou hadst a whore ’s forehead , thou refusedst to be ashamed .

traditions.WLC: וּ מֵ֨צַח אִשָּׁ֤ה זוֹנָה֙ הָ֣יָה לָ֔ ךְ מֵאַ֖נְתְּ הִכָּלֵֽם
traditions.LXX: ὄψις πόρνης ἐγένετό σοι , ἀπηναισχύντησας πρὸς πάντας .
traditions.VUL: frons mulíeris meretrícis facta est tibi , noluísti erubéscere .
traditions.KJV: and thou hadst a whore ’s forehead , thou refusedst to be ashamed .

4.english_reference: Wilt thou not from this time cry unto me , My father

traditions.WLC: הֲ ל֣וֹא מֵ עַ֔תָּה קראתי לִ֖ י אָבִ֑ י
traditions.LXX: οὐχ ὡς οἶκόν με ἐκάλεσας καὶ πατέρα
traditions.VUL: Ergo saltem ámodo voca me : Pater meus ,
traditions.KJV: Wilt thou not from this time cry unto me , My father ,

4.english_reference: thou [ art ] the guide of my youth ?

traditions.WLC: אַלּ֥וּף נְעֻרַ֖ י אָֽתָּה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀρχηγὸν τῆς παρθενίας σου ;
traditions.VUL: dux virginitátis meæ tu es :
traditions.KJV: thou [ art ] the guide of my youth ?

5.english_reference: Will he reserve [ his anger ] for ever ? will he keep [ it ] to the end ?

traditions.WLC: הֲ יִנְטֹ֣ר לְ עוֹלָ֔ם אִם יִשְׁמֹ֖ר לָ נֶ֑צַח
traditions.LXX: μὴ διαμενεῖ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα , ἢ φυλαχθήσεται εἰς νῖκος ;
traditions.VUL: numquid irascéris in perpétuum , aut perseverábis in finem ?
traditions.KJV: Will he reserve [ his anger ] for ever ? will he keep [ it ] to the end ?

5.english_reference: Behold , thou hast spoken and done evil things as thou couldest .

traditions.WLC: הִנֵּ֥ה דברתי וַ תַּעֲשִׂ֥י הָ רָע֖וֹת וַ תּוּכָֽל
traditions.LXX: ἰδοὺ ἐλάλησας καὶ ἐποίησας τὰ πονηρὰ ταῦτα καὶ ἠδυνάσθης .
traditions.VUL: Ecce locúta es , et fecísti mala , et potuísti .
traditions.KJV: Behold , thou hast spoken and done evil things as thou couldest .

6.english_reference: The LORD said also unto me in the days of Josiah the king

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֵלַ֗ י בִּ ימֵי֙ יֹאשִׁיָּ֣הוּ הַ מֶּ֔לֶךְ
traditions.LXX: Καὶ εἶπεν Κύριος πρὸς μὲ ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις Ἰωσείου τοῦ βασιλέως
traditions.VUL: Et dixit Dóminus ad me in diébus Iosíæ regis :
traditions.KJV: The LORD said also unto me in the days of Josiah the king ,

6.english_reference: Hast thou seen [ that ] which backsliding Israel hath done ?

traditions.WLC: הֲֽ רָאִ֔יתָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשְׂתָ֖ה מְשֻׁבָ֣ה יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל
traditions.LXX: Εἶδες ἃ ἐποίησέν μοι ἡ κατοικία τοῦ Ἰσραήλ ;
traditions.VUL: Numquid vidísti quæ fécerit aversátrix Israel ?
traditions.KJV: Hast thou seen [ that ] which backsliding Israel hath done ?

6.english_reference: she is gone up upon every high mountain and under every green tree , and there hath played the harlot .

traditions.WLC: הֹלְכָ֨ה הִ֜יא עַל כָּל הַ֣ר גָּבֹ֗הַּ וְ אֶל תַּ֛חַת כָּל עֵ֥ץ רַעֲנָ֖ן וַ תִּזְנִי שָֽׁם
traditions.LXX: ἐπορεύθησαν ἐπὶ πᾶν ὄρος ὑψηλὸν καὶ ὑποκάτω παντὸς ξύλου ἀλσώδους καὶ ἐπόρνευσαν ἐκεῖ .
traditions.VUL: ábiit sibímet super omnem montem excélsum , et sub omni ligno frondóso , et fornicáta est ibi .
traditions.KJV: she is gone up upon every high mountain and under every green tree , and there hath played the harlot .

7.english_reference: And I said after she had done all these [ things ] , Turn thou unto me .

traditions.WLC: וָ אֹמַ֗ר אַחֲרֵ֨י עֲשׂוֹתָ֧ הּ אֶת כָּל אֵ֛לֶּה אֵלַ֥ י תָּשׁ֖וּב
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπα μετὰ τὸ πορνεῦσαι αὐτὴν ταῦτα πάντα Πρὸς μὲ ἀνάστρεψον ·
traditions.VUL: Et dixi , cum fecísset hæc ómnia : Ad me revértere :
traditions.KJV: And I said after she had done all these [ things ] , Turn thou unto me .

traditions.WLC: וְ לֹא שָׁ֑בָה
traditions.LXX: καὶ οὐκ ἀνέστρεψεν ,
traditions.VUL: et non est revérsa .
traditions.KJV: But she returned not .

7.english_reference: And her treacherous sister Judah saw [ it ] .

traditions.WLC: ו תראה בָּגוֹדָ֥ה אֲחוֹתָ֖ הּ יְהוּדָֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶδεν τὴν ἀσυνθεσίαν αὐτῆς ἡ ἀσύνθετος Ἰουδά .
traditions.VUL: Et vidit prævaricátrix soror eius Iuda ,
traditions.KJV: And her treacherous sister Judah saw [ it ] .

8.english_reference: And I saw , when for all the causes whereby backsliding Israel committed adultery I had put her away , and given her a bill of divorce

traditions.WLC: וָ אֵ֗רֶא כִּ֤י עַל כָּל אֹדוֹת֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר נִֽאֲפָה֙ מְשֻׁבָ֣ה יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל שִׁלַּחְתִּ֕י הָ וָ אֶתֵּ֛ן אֶת סֵ֥פֶר כְּרִיתֻתֶ֖י הָ אֵלֶ֑י הָ
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶδον διότι περὶ πάντων ὧν καὶ εἶδον , περὶ πάντων ὧν κατελήμφθη ἐν οἷς ἐμοιχᾶτο ἡ κατοικία τοῦ Ἰσραήλ , καὶ ἐξαπέστειλα αὐτὴν καὶ ἔδωκα αὐτῇ βιβλίον ἀποστασίου εἰς τὰς χεῖρας αὐτῆς ·
traditions.VUL: quia pro eo , quod mœcháta esset aversátrix Israel , dimisíssem eam , et dedíssem ei libéllum repúdii :
traditions.KJV: And I saw , when for all the causes whereby backsliding Israel committed adultery I had put her away , and given her a bill of divorce ;

8.english_reference: yet her treacherous sister Judah feared not , but went and played the harlot also .

traditions.WLC: וְ לֹ֨א יָֽרְאָ֜ה בֹּֽגֵדָ֤ה יְהוּדָה֙ אֲחוֹתָ֔ הּ וַ תֵּ֖לֶךְ וַ תִּ֥זֶן גַּם הִֽיא
traditions.LXX: καὶ οὐκ ἐφοβήθη ἡ ἀσύνθετος Ἰουδά , καὶ ἐπορεύθη καὶ ἐπόρνευσεν καὶ αὐτή ,
traditions.VUL: et non tímuit prævaricátrix Iuda soror eius , sed ábiit , et fornicáta est étiam ipsa .
traditions.KJV: yet her treacherous sister Judah feared not , but went and played the harlot also .

9.english_reference: And it came to pass through the lightness of her whoredom , that she defiled the land

traditions.WLC: וְ הָיָה֙ מִ קֹּ֣ל זְנוּתָ֔ הּ וַ תֶּחֱנַ֖ף אֶת הָ אָ֑רֶץ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐγένετο εἰς οὐθὲν ἡ πορνεία αὐτῆς ,
traditions.VUL: Et facilitáte fornicatiónis suæ contaminávit terram ,
traditions.KJV: And it came to pass through the lightness of her whoredom , that she defiled the land ,

9.english_reference: and committed adultery with stones and with stocks .

traditions.WLC: וַ תִּנְאַ֥ף אֶת הָ אֶ֖בֶן וְ אֶת הָ עֵֽץ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐμοίχευσεν τὸ ξύλον καὶ τὸν λίθον .
traditions.VUL: et mœcháta est cum lápide et ligno .
traditions.KJV: and committed adultery with stones and with stocks .

10.english_reference: And yet for all this her treacherous sister Judah hath not turned unto me with her whole heart

traditions.WLC: וְ גַם בְּ כָל זֹ֗את לֹא שָׁ֨בָה אֵלַ֜ י בָּגוֹדָ֧ה אֲחוֹתָ֛ הּ יְהוּדָ֖ה בְּ כָל לִבָּ֑ הּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐν πᾶσιν τούτοις οὐκ ἐπεστράφη πρὸς μὲ ἡ ἀσύνθετος Ἰουδὰ ἐξ ὃλης τῆς καρδίας αὐτῆς
traditions.VUL: Et in ómnibus his non est revérsa ad me prævaricátrix soror eius Iuda in toto corde suo ,
traditions.KJV: And yet for all this her treacherous sister Judah hath not turned unto me with her whole heart ,

traditions.WLC: כִּ֥י אִם בְּ שֶׁ֖קֶר נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
traditions.LXX: ἀλλ᾽ ἐπὶ ψεύδει .
traditions.VUL: sed in mendácio , ait Dóminus .
traditions.KJV: but feignedly , saith the LORD .

11.english_reference: And the LORD said unto me

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֵלַ֔ י
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπεν Κύριος πρὸς μέ
traditions.VUL: Et dixit Dóminus ad me :
traditions.KJV: And the LORD said unto me ,

11.english_reference: The backsliding Israel hath justified herself more than treacherous Judah

traditions.WLC: צִדְּקָ֥ה נַפְשָׁ֖ הּ מְשֻׁבָ֣ה יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מִ בֹּגֵדָ֖ה יְהוּדָֽה
traditions.LXX: Ἐδικαίωσεν τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ Ἰσραὴλ ἀπὸ τῆς ἀσυνθέτου Ἰουδά .
traditions.VUL: Iustificávit ánimam suam aversátrix Israel , comparatióne prævaricatrícis Iudæ .
traditions.KJV: The backsliding Israel hath justified herself more than treacherous Judah .

12.english_reference: Go and proclaim these words toward the north

traditions.WLC: הָלֹ֡ךְ וְ קָֽרָאתָ֩ אֶת הַ דְּבָרִ֨ים הָ אֵ֜לֶּה צָפ֗וֹנָ ה
traditions.LXX: πορεύου καὶ ἀνάγνωθι τοὺς λόγους τούτους πρὸς βορρᾶν ,
traditions.VUL: Vade , et clama sermónes istos contra aquilónem ,
traditions.KJV: Go and proclaim these words toward the north ,

12.english_reference: and say , Return , thou backsliding Israel , saith the LORD

traditions.WLC: וְ֠ אָמַרְתָּ שׁ֣וּבָ ה מְשֻׁבָ֤ה יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ נְאֻם יְהוָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐρεῖς Ἐπιστράφητι πρὸς μέ , ἡ κατοικία τοῦ Ἰσραήλ , λέγει Κύριος ,
traditions.VUL: et dices : Revértere aversátrix Israel , ait Dóminus ,
traditions.KJV: and say , Return , thou backsliding Israel , saith the LORD ; [ and ]

12.english_reference: I will not cause mine anger to fall upon you

traditions.WLC: לֽוֹא אַפִּ֥יל פָּנַ֖ י בָּ כֶ֑ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ οὐ στηριῶ τὸ πρόσωπόν μου ἐφ᾽ ὑμᾶς ·
traditions.VUL: et non avértam fáciem meam a vobis :
traditions.KJV: I will not cause mine anger to fall upon you :

12.english_reference: for I am merciful , saith the LORD

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי חָסִ֤יד אֲנִי֙ נְאֻם יְהוָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: ὅτι ἐλεήμων ἐγώ εἰμι , λέγει Κύριος ,
traditions.VUL: quia sanctus ego sum , dicit Dóminus ,
traditions.KJV: for I [ am ] merciful , saith the LORD , [

12.english_reference: and I will not keep anger for ever

traditions.WLC: לֹ֥א אֶטּ֖וֹר לְ עוֹלָֽם
traditions.LXX: καὶ οὐ μηνιῶ ὑμῖν εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα .
traditions.VUL: et non iráscar in perpétuum .
traditions.KJV: and ] I will not keep [ anger ] for ever .

traditions.WLC: אַ֚ךְ דְּעִ֣י עֲוֺנֵ֔ ךְ
traditions.LXX: πλὴν γνῶθι τὴν ἀδικίαν σου ,
traditions.VUL: Verúmtamen scito iniquitátem tuam ,
traditions.KJV: Only acknowledge thine iniquity ,

13.english_reference: that thou hast transgressed against the LORD thy God

traditions.WLC: כִּ֛י בַּ יהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהַ֖יִ ךְ פָּשָׁ֑עַתְּ
traditions.LXX: ὅτι εἰς Κύριον τὸν θεόν σου ἠσέβησας ,
traditions.VUL: quia in Dóminum Deum tuum prævaricáta es :
traditions.KJV: that thou hast transgressed against the LORD thy God ,

13.english_reference: and hast scattered thy ways to the strangers under every green tree

traditions.WLC: וַ תְּפַזְּרִ֨י אֶת דְּרָכַ֜יִ ךְ לַ זָּרִ֗ים תַּ֚חַת כָּל עֵ֣ץ רַעֲנָ֔ן
traditions.LXX: καὶ διέχεας τὰς ὁδούς σου εἰς ἀλλοτρίους ὑποκάτω παντὸς ξύλου ἀλσώδους ,
traditions.VUL: et dispersísti vias tuas aliénis sub omni ligno frondóso ,
traditions.KJV: and hast scattered thy ways to the strangers under every green tree ,

13.english_reference: and ye have not obeyed my voice , saith the LORD

traditions.WLC: וּ בְ קוֹלִ֥ י לֹא שְׁמַעְתֶּ֖ם נְאֻם יְהֹוָֽה
traditions.LXX: τῆς δὲ φωνῆς μου οὐχ ὑπήκουσας , λέγει Κύριος .
traditions.VUL: et vocem meam non audísti , ait Dóminus .
traditions.KJV: and ye have not obeyed my voice , saith the LORD .

14.english_reference: Turn , O backsliding children , saith the LORD

traditions.WLC: שׁ֣וּבוּ בָנִ֤ים שׁוֹבָבִים֙ נְאֻם יְהוָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: ἐπιστράφητε , υἱοὶ ἀφεστηκότες , λέγει Κύριος ,
traditions.VUL: Convertímini fílii reverténtes , dicit Dóminus :
traditions.KJV: Turn , O backsliding children , saith the LORD ;

14.english_reference: for I am married unto you

traditions.WLC: כִּ֥י אָנֹכִ֖י בָּעַ֣לְתִּי בָ כֶ֑ם
traditions.LXX: διότι ἐγὼ κατακυριεύσω ὑμῶν ,
traditions.VUL: quia ego vir vester :
traditions.KJV: for I am married unto you :

14.english_reference: and I will take you one of a city , and two of a family

traditions.WLC: וְ לָקַחְתִּ֨י אֶתְ כֶ֜ם אֶחָ֣ד מֵ עִ֗יר וּ שְׁנַ֨יִם֙ מִ מִּשְׁפָּחָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ λήμψομαι ὑμᾶς ἕνα ἐκ πόλεως καὶ δύο ἐκ πατριᾶς
traditions.VUL: et assúmam vos unum de civitáte , et duos de cognatióne ,
